name: Tap Payments

webhook.algorithm: VERIFIED, and unusual enough that a generator will get it wrong by default. Header `hashstring`; HMAC-SHA256 keyed with the merchant SECRET API KEY — but computed over a hand-built ordered concatenation, NOT the raw body: `"x_id" + id + "x_amount" + amount + "x_currency" + currency + "x_gateway_reference" + gateway_reference + "x_payment_reference" + payment_reference + "x_status" + status + "x_created" + created`. For invoice events substitute `x_updated` for the two reference fields. No timestamp, so dedup on `id`. CRITICAL: `amount` must be formatted to the ISO-4217 exponent for the currenc

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: PARTIALLY VERIFIED. Secret keys `sk_test_...` / `sk_live_...`, publishable `pk_test_...` / `pk_live_...`. Exact charset/length UNKNOWN. Same prefixes as Stripe/Paystack — disambiguate by host.

onboarding.note: Local entity required in the GCC market you sell from.

fees.notes: UNKNOWN. Tap prices per-country and per-scheme; mada and KNET carry domestic-scheme rates well below international card rates. No reliable single public number. Leave null.

notes: One integration covering every GCC domestic debit scheme — mada (SA), KNET (KW), Benefit (BH), OmanNet (OM) — which international card processing simply cannot reach. Stripe covers none of these, and in Kuwait KNET is effectively mandatory for local conversion.

SDKs: First-party mobile SDKs (iOS/Android/Flutter/React Native) and a goSell web SDK; no first-party Node/Python/PHP server SDK. Community `ahmedlaggoun/tap` (Composer). Emit direct REST server-side.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps Checkout.com, PayTabs, HyperPay and MyFatoorah across GCC. Tap has the best public docs of the group and is the right default GCC pick.
Onboarding: application_review. Local entity required in the GCC market you sell from.
